confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Zermatt's alpine resort pricing for July 2026, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and beer anchors are more certain than accommodation, where summer demand and seasonal rates vary widely. Estimates assume roughly 1 CHF = 1.25 USD. The FX observation comes from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA statistics page; I did not open the RBA page or F11.1 table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Swiss alpine resort towns (Interlaken, Grindelwald, St. Moritz) and the higher-cost Swiss urban restaurant tier, adjusted for Zermatt's car-free resort premium.
